title: Blood Volume Assessment of Hepatocellular and Metastatic Carcinomas in the Liver
brief_summary: This project investigates the feasibility of assessing the relative blood volume of carcinomas in patients with Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) and liver metastases from pancreatic or colorectal cancer compared to normal liver from DynaCT acquisitions on an interventional platform.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HCC or metastatic liver disease
* Candidate for radioembolization or chemoembolization

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Iodine allergy
study_population: Patients diagnosed with non-diffuse hepatocellular carcinoma or metastatic liver disease
